metadata.title: System Architecture Overview
metadata.subject: Neutral architecture overview for technical and product audiences
metadata.author: PresentationKit

processFlow.title: How requests move through the system
processFlow.subtitle: A concise flow highlights boundaries, responsibilities, and outcomes.
processFlow.caption: Architecture is explained through useful movement.

footprint.title: System boundary map
footprint.subtitle: Show what is in scope, adjacent, external, and still evolving.
footprint.caption: Boundaries reduce architecture ambiguity.

architecture.title: Architecture evidence model
architecture.subtitle: Design choices connect constraints, runtime behavior, and operability needs.

slides.label: 1 / architecture context
slides.title: Architecture is easiest to understand through flow
slides.headline: The overview shows how responsibility moves across system boundaries.
slides.supportingLine: Start with the request path, then widen into the components and constraints that matter.
slides.speakerNotes: Explain the system by following a request and naming the responsibilities at each boundary.

slides.label: 2 / architecture proof
slides.title: The system view ties design choices to evidence
slides.headline: Architecture claims are supported by journeys, models, integrations, and operations.
slides.supportingLine: The deck separates what exists today from assumptions, constraints, and intended evolution.
slides.guardrailLine: Guardrails: show assumptions; separate current from target; name ownership.
slides.speakerNotes: Use the proof slide to prevent the architecture overview from becoming a decorative diagram.

slides.label: 3 / architecture ambition
slides.title: The dream: architecture that helps teams act
slides.headline: A useful overview accelerates onboarding, change planning, and incident response.
slides.closingLine: Make the system easier to change by making it easier to understand.
slides.speakerNotes: Close by connecting architecture clarity to better delivery and operations.
